description: This file defines a React component named SessionDetailsModal that renders a modal dialog displaying detailed information about a session. It includes utility functions for formatting dates, durations, and user names, and fetches additional user data if necessary. The component is styled for responsiveness and accessibility.

methods.name: SessionDetailsModal
methods.description: React functional component that renders a modal with session details, including user info, timestamps, duration, and optional user cost information.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date value into a localized string or an em-dash if invalid or missing.

methods.name: computeDuration
methods.description: Calculates a human-readable duration string from start and end timestamps.

methods.name: resolveUserName
methods.description: Resolves a user-friendly name from various user reference formats, searching in context data if necessary.
